formName: Step 9 - Co-applicant Signatures - Water Licence Application
formDescription: This step displays a Co-Applicants grid/table and collects approval choices before the water licence application can proceed. The grid/table itself is context, not a formfield. Available row actions include composing an approval email, opening application/approval form documents, opening an attached document, uploading a signed form, and choosing mail submission.

ComposeEmail.title: Compose Email
ComposeEmail.description: Action link/button that opens an email request for obtaining a co-applicant's approval electronically.

Forms.title: Application Form
Forms.description: Action icon/link for the application form document used with offline co-applicant approval.

Doc_198468959.title: Attached Document
Doc_198468959.description: Action link that opens the attached supporting document associated with the application or approval process.

Url_ConsentForm.title: Upload Signed Form
Url_ConsentForm.description: Action link/button that opens the upload dialog for a signed co-applicant approval form.

MailConsentForm.title: Mail approval form
MailConsentForm.description: Checkbox input indicating that the signed co-applicant approval form will be submitted by mail.

report_link_198468967.title: Co-Applicant Approval Form
report_link_198468967.description: Action link that opens/downloads the co-applicant approval form for another observed co-applicant row.
